answer: Each new agent must bridge its identity to one network origin and lock a 40 POA bond. The ledger keeps a per-origin anchor equal to the square root of bonded stake; past 8 identities on one origin, extra identities earn 1/n rewards and their votes are damped by that anchor, so a farm pays a bond and rent per clone while influence stays flat. Identities with no attestations for two epochs are marked hollow and evicted, forfeiting half the bond. Cost: 400 clones need 16,000 POA plus 400 live hosts. Boundary: shared NATs get damped too, so liveness proofs must exempt them.
